# Definition 
**Antiphospholipid Antibody Syndrome** or **APS** is an autoimmune disorder caused by **antiphospholipid antibodies**, “APLAs”.

APLAs disrupt platelets, creating a **prothrombotic** state, promoting clot formation. 

# Presentation 
- low PLTs 
- positive VDRL 
- high aPTT

# Pregnancy 
Thrombosis of placental vessels can starve the fetus of blood, causing recurrent pregnancy loss. 

# Management 
## Pregnant patients
Start LMWH to stop thrombosis.
